body: Sharan Bansal (Director / ED) on 2024-07-30 (Q1FY25 concall transcript): "we don't have any immediate plans -- beyond the rights issue as the company because we feel that the internal accruals of the company will be strong enough to meet our growth plans" Metric: Equity dilution. Target: No new equity raise beyond rights issue. Deadline: near term (unstated). Specificity: vague; prompted by analyst. Status as of 2026-11-19: missed. Evidence: Three months later (Oct-24) the Board took an enabling resolution for ~INR 600 cr. A QIP was put on hold (Apr-25). Then a INR 433.5 cr preferential issue to institutions (Jul/Aug-2026). Free cash flow was negative in FY25 (-83 cr) and FY26 (-88 cr) (screener), so 'internal accruals strong enough' did not hold. Explanation given: Aug-26: to strengthen the balance sheet and be ready for capex/M&A (volunteered in opening remarks)
